Zombified Corpses are zombies that spawn from the Piles of Corpses in the Forlorn Cloister of the Scarlet Monastery. The zombies are then quickly put down by Scarlet Flamethrowers and Scarlet Centurions.
Zul'Farrak Guild Run is a guild achievement that is awarded for defeating the final boss of the Zul'Farrak instance while in a guild group.
Zouchin Villagers are pandaren found at Zouchin Village of Kun-Lai Summit.
Zouchin Archers are pandaren located at Zouchin Village in Kun-Lai Summit.
Zouchin Defenders are pandaren located at Zouchin Village in Kun-Lai Summit.

Zouchin Province is the northeastern extent of Kun-Lai Summit, down near sea level. The pandaren of Zouchin Village and Zouchin Strand call the province home, but both the Blackmane Mercenaries and the Zandalari have come from beyond the mists, slaughtering Zouchin strand and besieging the village, respectively. The Zandalari have claimed mogu ruins east of the village as the Zandalari Vanguard, using it as a staging ground for whatever is taking place on the Isle of Reckoning, to the northeast. Shortly before the invasion on the Isle of Thunder, the province's pandaren were escorted out of the region and the Zandalari trolls attacked and completely overran the province. Zouchin Village is the main settlement of Zouchin Province, down near sea level in northeastern Kun-Lai Summit. North Wind Tavern is the inn of the village. Just north is the Zouchin Strand, while the Zandalari Vanguard is to the east. The Zandalari are laying siege to the village in an attempt to run distraction to buy time for whatever the Zandalari are doing on the Isle of Reckoning, off to the northeast. The attack was repelled by the village's villagers and adventurers of the Alliance and Horde. Months after adventurers fought off the Zandalari, they would return and force the villagers to evacuate. Zouchin Strand is a beach containing a smaller pandaren settlement on the northern coast of the Zouchin Province in northeast Kun-Lai Summit. Just to the south is the main Zouchin Village. Blackmane Mercenaries have razed the strand at the Zandalar tribe's behest, slaughtering all of the inhabitants except for Sage Liao.
Zim'Torga Guardians are ice elementals stationed outside the entrances to Zim'Torga, a faction-neutral troll encampment in Zul'Drak.
__NOTOC__ Zoltan is a blood elf pet tamer found in Jaedenar in Felwood, preaching to the Zoltanian Cultists about the return of Sargeras. His pets are Hatewalker, Ultramus, and Beamer.
Zoltanian Cultists are found in Jaedenar, listening to Zoltan preach about the return of Sargeras. Some are seen with a rare undead blood elf skin with night elf voice.
__NOTOC__ Zooey Snakes are snakes found in the lower parts of Kun-Lai Summit.

Captain Zixx Grindergear is a goblin who commanded a zeppelin during the assault of Northwatch Hold. His first mate was Blar Xyzzik. After the battle of Northwatch was over, he participated in a meeting called by Baine Bloodhoof. There the tauren, Kelantir Bloodblade, Frandis Farley, Vol'jin and some others were discussing about Garrosh Hellscream and this war. However, he informed Garrosh and Malkorok about this meeting and they thought that they were plotting against them.
Zipper Sizzlesnap is a goblin fishing vendor in the neutral goblin port of Bogpaddle.

Zookeeper is a title awarded for completing the Pet Battle meta-achievement World Safari, earned by capturing every battle pet to be found in Kalimdor, the Eastern Kingdoms, Outland, Northrend and Pandaria. The title appears before your character's name: :Zookeeper
__NOTOC__ Zom's Misty Hood is a world drop from mobs in Pandaria.
Zom's Rain-Stained Cloak is a random world drop from Pandaria mobs.
Zul'Again is an exploration achievement earned for killing 10 Zandalari Warscouts and 5 Zandalari Warbringers.
Zuben Eschamali is a ethereal located at the Stormspire in Netherstorm.

.]] Zin'Jun (or Zin'jun) was a jungle troll hunter that survived the destruction of Hellscream's Fist in Pandaria. Unfortunately, he was found by a band of hostile hozen led by Konk. He held them off for a time by feigning death and shot them down as they turned to leave, though one managed to call his bluff. He was tortured before they finally left him for dead, his eyes torn out. When the Horde adventurer found him, he was dying but tasked them to avenge him and his pet Snuff. After he was avenged, Zin'Jun was finally able to rest and died.
Zino "The Shredder" Quickchop is a goblin located in Quickchop's Lumber Farm in Krasarang Wilds.

Zooti Fizzlefury is a gnome with the Kirin Tor located at Khadgar's Tower in Talador. He researches time. He is Archmage Vargoth's closest friend and confidant. During the third invasion of the Burning Legion the champions of the Tirisgarde came to Zooti.

:"Finally free! Your reward will be a quick death!" Zinaar is a djinn who serves as the first boss of the Temple of Orsis wing in the League of Explorers adventure of Hearthstone. He was previously imprisoned in a lamp, but was freed when Reno Jackson could not resist rubbing it.

The author of the Exhumer's Journal noted that the marsh appears to have had some sort of malign effect on the spirit of the arakkoa crusader Kris'kar the Unredeemed, who died in an underground ruin below the swamp. A giant tree in the middle of Zorammarsh houses a mysterious plant called The Perfect Blossom. It may or may not be related to the strange effects of the marsh. Their leader, Lady Zithreen was killed by the enslaved Grash with the help of the Earthen Ring shaman, Erunak Stonespeaker, Wavespeaker Adelee‎ and their new Farseer who took Sharas'dal from her. They were encountered by the champions of Valarjar near the sunken ship Vaesska in Vashj'ir. They were also fought by the champions of the Conclave who arrived to Vashj'ir to get Lumenstone from the naga.

, as viewed by two characters of different levels.]] Zone scaling, also known as level scaling, causes mobs, quests, and loot to scale with the player character's level over a range. This allows the player more freedom to choose where they level. It was first introduced in Legion for zones in the Broken Isles, but was later expanded to include the entire game. However, scaling usually excludes content that was meant to be part of its expansion's end game: raids, heroic mode dungeons, and end-game zones such as Suramar or Mechagon. The Zoo Bizarre is a zoo filled with exotic animals from parts of Azeroth. The zoo is run by Yebb Neblegear.
Zola the Gorgon is a naga found underground. It is unknown what she is doing there, but she could be experimenting on captives based on her intro quote: Sssuch a perfect specimen.

Zin'jatar Fathom-Stalker is a naga located in Shimmering Expanse. They also appear as friendly NPCs during a vision of past quest at Biel'aran Ridge.

Zu'Anji's Talisman drops from Blood Priestess Zu'Anji in Nazmir.

Zolani is the Blade of the King Rastakhan. She is constantly at his sides, with her brother Habutu, Shield of the King. Both are charged with protecting the life of the King of Zandalar. After Rastakhan's death, she became the Blade of the Queen Talanji.

Zugna, Windseer Apprentice is a character that appears on the following World of Warcraft: Trading Card Game cards. *Wrathgate #155 - Zugna, Windseer Apprentice *Assault on Icecrown Citadel #75 - Zugna, Windseer Apprentice She is the apprentice of Windseer Tarus.

Zocalo Shoppers are Zandalari trolls located at the Zocalo in Dazar'alor. They were also present during the Battle of Dazar'alor. They were present when riots erupted in the Zocalo during Talanji's coronation.

Zuaba Sonja is a Zandalari troll located in the Drunken Drummer in Dazar'alor. During Talanji's coronation, riots erupted in the Zocalo, and Zuaba was seen crying while being defended by Ranzul Sonja.
Zuaji is a Zandalari troll guard located at the Temple of Akunda in Vol'dun. He is initially known as Akunda the Vigilant but resumes his true name after completion of Ending the Madness.

Zissiah is a sethrak quest giver located at the Terrace of the Devoted in Vol'dun. After completion of Break Their Ranks and Push Them Back!, she walks inside the Sanctuary of the Devoted to stand next to Zeriph.

The Zo'bal Ruins are a shrine ruin sacred to Bwonsamdi in Nazmir. It's located in front of the Necropolis, and it serves as a foothold for the trolls who are set to visit there. Witch Doctor Kejabu says that there is a "real bad voodoo around dis place". The Wayshrine of the Fallen is located here. After the Fourth War, the Widow's Bite and Banshee loyalists invaded the ruins, killing its guards and civilians which also counted pilgrims, in preparations to invade the Necropolis. The Zandalari Empire and Horde Council later learned about this, and eventually they arrived at the ruins and proceeded to attack their enemies that were besieging Bwonsamdi at the Necropolis.

The Zocalo is a large market and shopping mall surrounding Zanchul. Shoppers and traders are constantly pestered by thieving saurid, resulting in Rastari Enforcers and Yazma's spiders being sent to dispose of them. When the traitorous prophet Zul and Mythrax invaded Zuldazar, the Zocalo was overrun by the sethrak. Soon, Warguard Rakera rallied the royal guard and reunited with Princess Talanji. While the entrance to the area was protected by Akunda, the Zandalari force defeated the sethrak and rescued the civilians trapped here.

during the Battle for Nazjatar.]] The Zone Map (formerly the Battle Map or Battlefield Map) is a transluscent, rectangular map of the current zone that defaults to a position in the lower-right corner of the screen. This map was originally intended to mark PvP objectives and team locations during Battlegrounds, but it can be turned on in any zone using the default keybind. This map differs from the full-featured World Map that is much larger, and the circular Minimap which only shows a player's immediate vicinity.

Zskera Vaults is northwest of Morqut Village on the Morqut Islet west of the Forbidden Reach mainland. Access to the vaults is unlocked by completing the quest chain that starts with Helping Hand and Claw at the Morqut Village just southeast. There are four named vaults: Az, Ur, Ix, and Kx. The vaults are randomized per-player, per-week, and players only have access to one vault per week based on their progression. Starting in week five, the weekly quest More Doors To Open unlocks, and repeats going forward, providing access to a random unnamed vault.

Zskera Vault Keys are found in Forbidden Hoards all over the Forbidden Reach. Use them to open doors in the Zskera Vaults. Additionally, Pathfinder Tacha gives six for free in the one-off quest The Keys You Need. Beyond that, rare-elites and Loot Specialists tend to drop some on successful kills. Most small treasures around the reach (as spotted with the Reliquary Scroll of Perception) also have a chance to contain a key. They are also sold by renown envoys in Morqut Village for .
Zskera Vault: Az is the first of the Zskera Vaults in Forbidden Reach. It contains 28 doors, each needing a Zskera Vault Key. Next week players explore The Scary Vault of Ur.
Zskera Vault: Ix starts the third week of Zskera Vaults quests.
Zskera Vault: Kx starts the fourth week of Zskera Vaults quests.

Zul'rogg (or Zul'Rogg) was a forest troll chieftain active in the Plaguelands during the Plaguelands civil war. Sylvanas Windrunner encountered him and his tribesmen during the battle between her forces and those of Varimathras. Sylvanas, who hated forest trolls, told her minions to kill all of the trolls.
Zulian Tigers are tigers found in Zul'Gurub. Killing one will result in +1 reputation with Zandalar Tribe. They can also be tamed by a hunter.

As part of each 5-piece class set, there are amulets that are awarded based on the level of reputation one has achieved with the Zandalar Tribe. The first amulet is awarded at Friendly, and is upgraded on each subsequent reputation level increase. Note that only the amulet awarded at exalted can complete the 5-piece sets.

The Zul'Gurub trinkets are a family of trinkets which are available exclusively in Zul'Gurub. They are not the only trinkets one can acquire within that zone, but they are unique in that each is a part of an epic class-specific equipment set. These trinkets have diverse effects, but all of them provide short-term bonuses. They are therefore most useful for PvP combat.
Zulian Slicer is a one-handed sword that increases the wielder's skinning skill level. The only other weapon that increases skinning is the dagger Pip's Skinner.
warrior's back.]] The Zulian Defender is a brownish purple shield that provides bonuses to stamina, intellect, and spirit. This makes it a very nice shaman or paladin shield.

Zureetha Fargaze is an orc quest giver located in the Valley of Trials in Durotar, next to Foreman Thazz'ril. She tasks adventurers with helping her combat the Burning Blade's influence in the Valley. During Tracking a Killer, Zureetha and Thazz'ril are seen inspecting the body of a Dead Peon killed by Gor'krosh.

Zul'Mashar is located in the northeastern part of the Eastern Plaguelands. It was once the capital of the Mossflayer tribe, a small tribe of forest trolls, but the long arduous fighting with the humans of Lordaeron have caused the trolls' land to fall into disarray. Although they retook parts of the land, the coming of the plague of undeath wrought more destruction upon the land itself, and today Zul'Mashar is a shadow of its former glory. Currently, it is in danger of becoming a bastion for the undead as its own people are being covertly transformed. Zul'Mashar contains the troll ziggurat Mazra'Alor, and is home to Warlord Thresh'jin and Zul'Brin Warpbranch. Before the Cataclysm, Infiltrato
The Zuuldaia Ruins are ancient troll ruins on the northern part of the western coast of Stranglethorn Vale. A large number of Bloodscalp trolls inhabit the area.
The Zulian Stone Axe is a decent weapon for Paladins, Shamans and possibly Hunters. It drops off High Priest Venoxis in Zul'Gurub with an approximate drop rate of 11%.
The Zulian Tigerhide Cloak drops from High Priest Venoxis in Zul'Gurub at an approximated 10% drop rate.
The Zulian Scepter of Rites drops from all the High Priests in Zul'Gurub with an estimated droprate of 5%.
The Zulian Mudskunk is a fish found only in the waters of Zul'Gurub. These fish are a favorite of the water beast Gahz'ranka and can be used to pull him from his lair.
__NOTOC__ Zulrg is an ogre weapon vendor located in Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh.
Zul'arek Hatefowler is a rare forest troll found at Zun'watha in the Hinterlands, which is found east of Aerie Peak.

Zun'watha is a forest troll ruin that were once inhabited by trolls of the Witherbark tribe tribe in the Hinterlands. The Witherbark tribe has apparently abandoned the ruins, which now lie empty. However, Zul'arek Hatefowler can be seen occasionally visiting the ruins.
__NOTOC__ Zul'Lor was an undead troll once found in the Temple of Atal'Hakkar.
One of three Zul'Gurub Coin turn-in quests found at Yojamba Isle, the quest is repeatable, giving 25 points of reputation with Zandalar Tribe and 50 from the resulting Zandalar Honor Token.
Zulian Cubs are tigers found in Zul'Gurub. Killing one rewards +1 reputation with the Zandalar Tribe. They can also be tamed by a hunter.
Zulian Guardians are summoned by High Priest Thekal in Zul'Gurub.
Zulian Panthers are panthers found in Zul'Gurub. Killing one will reward +1 reputation with the Zandalar Tribe. Zulian Panthers can be tamed by a hunter.
Zulian Prowlers are panthers found in Zul'Gurub. Killing one will result in +1 reputation with Zandalar Tribe.
Zulian Stalkers are panthers found in Zul'Gurub. Killing a Stalker will result in +1 reputation with Zandalar Tribe. They can be tamed by a hunter.

Zurjaya is a jungle troll fishing trainer, quest giver, and vendor located in Zabra'jin in Zangarmarsh. Despite whatever may have been her original assignment in Outland, all she wants to do is fish and maybe sell you an Aquadynamic Fish Attractor or two. The indigenous wildlife has been interfering with her favorite pass-time and she's willing to pay you something to deal with it.
The Zul'Mamwe Trophy is found in the pile of Zul'Mamwe Trophy Skulls in the Ruins of Zul'Mamwe in Northern Stranglethorn.

Zungam is a jungle troll found in a hut past the first lynx pulls as you head toward Halazzi. He is chained until you reach him and release him. He then walks down the stairs to the first floor of the hut and becomes a repair vendor.
Zurai's Report is provided as an objective for Report to Shadow Hunter Denjai.
Zul'Mamwe Trophy Skulls, located in the Ruins of Zul'Mamwe, are a pile of skulls the jungle trolls have collected from their kills. This is one of many piles.
Zungam's Ball and Chain is located in Zul'Aman. They keep a prisoner.

The troll Zul'armon was tracking prey into the Swamp of Sorrows when he was knocked out and captured by trolls of the Atal'ai. When he awoke, he found that he was bound up to be cooked over a fire like a pig. The Atal'ai were planning to sacrifice him to Hakkar. When a green dragon attacked the camp, Zul'armon made an attempt to escape by shifting himself off the pole and loosening his bonds, and then grabbing a rock to use as a weapon. With the rock, he defended himself from any Atal'ai that got too close. He noticed that the dragon was injured, and that the Atal'ai priest was chanting spells to injure the dragon further. Finding his backpack, Zul'armon drank a potion which put up a shield
__NOTOC__ Zweihander is a sword. It is usually described as a sword that is two-handed and of great length.
Zulian Crocolisks can be found in Zul'Gurub. Killing one gives +1 reputation with Zandalar Tribe.
Zuramat the Obliterator is a voidlord boss located in Violet Hold.
Zuramat's Necklace drops from Zuramat the Obliterator in the Violet Hold on heroic mode.
__NOTOC__ Zul'tore is a jungle troll quest giver located at the Sunreaver Pavilion in the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown. He was present during Death Rising.
Zuzubee was an ogre located at the Mirage Raceway in Thousand Needles. He was probably killed in the flooding.

Zuura, mate of Kelkar, was the mother of Draka, making her the grandmother of Thrall. She and her family were exiled by Garad from a frostwolf village because of a Draka's sickness. She learned her how to scare talbuks. Years later, before a Kosh'harg celebration where Draka met Durotan, Kelkar and Zuura were forbidden to attend the celebration by Garad. When Draka left for the quest to obtain three ingredients, her parents were sad as they didn't expect her to return. The exact time and reason of her death is not known.

Denys Ananyev, better known by his poster name Ускагерот (Uskageroth), is a former Blizzard Entertainment employee and was the first Russian language Community Manager for the European World of Warcraft community. He started posting on the forums at the same time they went live on the 15th of July 2008. Uskageroth formerly worked for Ukrainian game developer company GSC Game World for S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Shadow of Chernobyl. He managed Russian-speaking community fan-portals for various game projects such as Guild Wars by NCSoft, Brothers-In-Arms by Gearbox Software and Juiced by Juiced Games. Uskageroth reached the world's Top 20 for the online racing game Juiced in 2005. His nick-name "Uskagero

Джимкаара (Jimkaara) is a Blizzard employee and a Russian language Community Manager for the European World of Warcraft community. Joining the team in 2010. Gone to another position in 2012.
Рейслор (Reyslor) is a Blizzard employee and a Russian language Community Manager for the European World of Warcraft community. Joining the team in 2010.

Zuni is a Darkspear troll recruit who accompanies new troll players on several quests throughout levels 1-5. He is first seen next to the player after first logging on. Accepting the quest to find the first class trainer will have him greet you and run towards the training grounds. You later meet him again when you have completed your training and are tasked with the quest A Troll's Truest Companion and talks to you as you cross the bridge to help obtain raptors. During two later quests No More Mercy and Territorial Fetish he assists you in killing the naga that are trying to take over the Echo Isles, led by Zar'jira. Near the end of the fight with Zar'jira during the quest An Ancient Enemy
Zuni's Family Heirloom is a quest reward from An Ancient Enemy.
__NOTOC__ Zul'Gurub Stone drops from Jin'do the Godbreaker in Zul'Gurub. It is not the stone ring behind Jin'do, but there is one hanging there.
Zul'Gurub Voodoo is a quest that gives your group the Call o' da Raptor buff, which occasionally summons a raptor to aid you when healing or dealing damage.
Zulna is an heirloom vendor found in Orgrimmar. She offers heirlooms to players with too many Justice Points to spend. Her vendor list can be found on the Justice Points article.
Мед posts as a level 85 male undead priest from Подземье EU. A welcome post was made on March 13, 2012 by Рейслор.

Zunta is an aspiring Pet Tamer located northeast of Tor'kren Farm in Durotar. Next to him are his two battle pets, Spike and Mumtar. Defeating him is required to complete the Taming Kalimdor and Taming Azeroth achievements.

Éiayaié is the Guild Master of Mordax on Azuremyst, which was renamed to "Blizzard Mentor Alliance" when the guild joined the Guild Mentoring Program on August 30, 2012. Éiayaié became an MVP on September 6, 2012.
Мивандеир (Mivandeir) is a Blizzard employee and a Russian language Community Manager for the European World of Warcraft community. Joining the team in 2012.
Алконст is an MVP on the Russian World of Warcraft forums, who posts as a level 85 female blood elf paladin from Гром EU. A welcome post was made on October 08, 2012 by Рейслор.

Ксанеррис (Ksanеrris, real name Sergey Smirnov) is a Blizzard employee and a Russian language Community Manager for the European World of Warcraft community. Ксанеррис joined on September 25, 2012. Gone to another position(?) in 2013.
Zun'ja is a jungle troll innkeeper located at Legion's Rest in the Shimmering Expanse.
Zur'chaka the Bonecrafter is a Zandalari troll located at the Za'Tual boneyard on the Isle of Thunder.
__NOTOC__ Zumonga is a dire sand troll located at the Thunderdrome in Gadgetzan.
Zulu de Voice was a jungle troll helping in the liberation of Razor Hill. He could add players healing buffs.
Брайвир is a Blizzard employee and a Russian language Community Manager for the European World of Warcraft community. Joining the team in 2014.

__NOTOC__ Zuulo is a draenei located at the Bloodthorn Cave in . Along with his friends Roona, Jorril, Diaani, and Arekk, he went to Bloodthorn Hill to collect the bounty on Kliaa. Unfortunately, he ate some of the mushrooms and fell asleep. With no way of fighting back, he was dragged all the way inside Bloodthorn Cave by the pale and is now trapped inside the cave. He would be freed by an Alliance adventurer.
Zulian Gnashers are crocolisks found at numerous places around the water's edge in Zul'Gurub.

Zuzak was assigned to Ziya's plundersquad, which was tasked to raid Pandaren treasuries, temples and armories for valuables and weapons to fuel the Horde war machine. Despite having an expertise with bombs it turns out that his skills didn't extend to the bombs' fusses which apparently went off and killed him.
Zunji the Knife is a pandaren who can sell items on the Black Market Auction House.

Nothing is really known about the presumed Zulian tribe. It was formerly implied by the Zulian Coins, found in Zul'Gurub at the first engagement of the Horde and Alliance. The other coins refer to tribes, but no other mention of the Zulian tribe can be found. Zulian is a species of tigers, panthers, fish, and crocolisks. It is also a label found on gear.
Zuraal the Ascended is the first boss in the Seat of the Triumvirate. He has been mutated by the Void by the ethereals of the Shadowguard.
Zul'cur the Ravenous is an ur'zul located in a cave in the Petrified Forest on Krokuun.
Zuriwa the Hexxer is a jungle troll located in the Broken Shore.
__NOTOC__ Zul'tan the Numerous is an ur'zul located at the Praetorium in Eredath.
Zul's Saurid Ward is sold by Griftah in Dazar'alor. It summons a Worthless Totem.
Zulsan's Cracked Skull is looted from Zulsan in Dead Man's Pass in Vol'dun.

Zul'Nazman (also spelled Zul'nazman) is the capital of the blood trolls located in Nazmir, surrounding Uldir. It is implied that Zul'Nazman was the original heart of troll civilization before they left Nazmir to avoid G'huun.
Zurvan is an ethereal located at the Maelstrom Mercantile in Dazar'alor.
To start this storyline, visit the scouting table in the Great Seal (2nd level). The Zuldazar storyline takes part in seven chapters, tracked by the achievement The Throne of Zuldazar:
Zulazi is a skeletal troll sitting on the ground and drinking in the southeastern Port of Zem'lan in Vol'dun.
Zul the Cuddly is an extremely small tiger sleeping next to Yahlwei in the central Port of Zem'lan in Vol'dun.
Zununbar is a skeletal troll walking around the western Port of Zem'lan in Vol'dun.
Zulashi is a skeletal troll sitting at the southern end of the Port of Zem'lan's central dock in Vol'dun, along with Lifeboat.

Zunashi the Exile is a Zandalari troll vignette located inside a bone-filled cave below the Bone Pit in Vol'dun. The cave is accessed through a hole in the ground inside a huge devilsaur skull in the western end of the pit. Zunashi is flanked by two inanimate Risen Ravasaurs; when he enters combat, he raises the ravasaurs to fight for him until either he or his attacker dies.
The Zul Adherent's Band is a quest reward from Key to the Brig.
Zulian Crewmen are Zandalari trolls located on the Isle of Fangs and Tusk Isle in Zuldazar.
Zulian Inquisitors are Zandalari trolls located in Dazar'alor.
Zuvembi Brewer Zekal is a Zandalari troll located in Tal'gurub in Zuldazar.
Zul's Ire is provided for Enforcing Fate. Given by Zul, it is switched with a Mysterious Brew. During the encounter, Vol'jamba drank it, weakening him.
Zununu the Undefeated is a Zandalari troll kid located in Dazar'alor.
Zul'nazan Monstrosities are deceased dire troll zombies located in Nazmir.
Zul'nazan Warriors are deceased blood trolls located in Nazmir. They can also be seen at Razorjaw River during Down by the Riverside.
Zul'aki the Headhunter is a Zandalari troll located in Drustvar during the Faction Assaults.
Zuwana Vileblade is a Zandalari troll located in the Siege of Boralus.
